 * 1
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:23:56 +0200
From: Flo Prescott <yuki.galloway82@example.com>
Subject: [robotics-worldwide] [Software] [Dataset] Release of Frosty Lanes - A
 Multimodal Multitask Dataset Toward Winter-Ready Vehicles

Dear  Colleagues,

Driverless cars do well on dry, sunny roads, but heavy snow is still hard
for them. Flakes scatter LiDAR returns, lane paint vanishes under slush,
and phantom obstacles appear where nothing stands.

We are happy to announce "*Frosty Lanes: A Multimodal *Multitask*
Dataset Toward *Winter-Ready* Vehicles*" (accepted to a robotics journal,
2026). Every sequence was recorded in real snowfall on public roads, and
the release holds *22K multimodal *frames for robust perception in winter
driving.
Frosty Lanes carries hand labels for more than *5K sequential LiDAR
sweeps*, including* 210K oriented bounding boxes* for detection,
*per-point semantic classes*, and the* labeling of airborne snow.*

Some highlights:
- City streets and rural highways in steady snowfall
- 64-beam LiDAR, RGB and thermal cameras, GNSS/IMU
- 3D boxes and point-wise labels, including falling flakes
- Joint training of snow removal, segmentation and detection

Paper: https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fdoi.example.org%2F10.0000%2Ffrosty-lanes&data=05%7C02%7Cuser%40example.edu%7C0f1e2d3c4b5a69788796a5b4c3d2e1f0%7C00000000000000000000000000000000%7C1%7C0%7C639000000000000001%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=ZXhhbXBsZS1zZGF0YS00001%3D&reserved=0
Code: https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fexample%2Ffrosty-lanes&data=05%7C02%7Cuser%40example.edu%7C0f1e2d3c4b5a69788796a5b4c3d2e1f0%7C00000000000000000000000000000000%7C1%7C0%7C639000000000000002%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=ZXhhbXBsZS1zZGF0YS00002%3D&reserved=0
Video: https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fvideo.example.org%2Ffrosty-lanes&data=05%7C02%7Cuser%40example.edu%7C0f1e2d3c4b5a69788796a5b4c3d2e1f0%7C00000000000000000000000000000000%7C1%7C0%7C639000000000000003%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=ZXhhbXBsZS1zZGF0YS00003%3D&reserved=0

Questions and feedback are welcome.
Best
Flo
 ---
Flo Prescott, Associate Professor
Department of Computer Science, Example Institute of Technology

Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 00:50:30 -0700
From: Noor Umberfield <uli.pemberton32@example.com>
Subject: [robotics-worldwide] [Jobs] Robotics Engineer positions (learned
 control, real-time control, perception) at Acme Motion

Dear robotics-worldwide colleagues,

Acme Motion is hiring robotics engineers who want to work where learned
policies meet real-time control, on real robots.

Who we are
Acme Motion builds the control layer that turns policy outputs into joint
torque commands inside a 1 ms loop, on embedded GPUs, on industrial arms
and mobile bases at customer sites.

Open roles
- Learning-based control engineer
- Real-time control engineer
- Perception engineer

Company:
https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.google.com%2Furl%3Fq%3Dhttps%3A%2F%2Fwww.acmemotion.example%26source%3Dgmail%26ust%3D1700000000000000%26sa%3DE&data=05%7C02%7Cuser%40example.edu%7C0f1e2d3c4b5a69788796a5b4c3d2e1f0%7C00000000000000000000000000000000%7C1%7C0%7C639000000000000004%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=ZXhhbXBsZS1zZGF0YS00004%3D&reserved=0
(the careers page is in English and Korean)

Noor Umberfield
CEO, Acme Motion

From: Kit Galloway <cy.abernathy12@example.com>
Subject: [robotics-worldwide] [Journals] Call for Papers - Research Topic on
 AI-Enabled Robotics and Wireless Power Transfer

Dear colleagues,

We invite submissions to a journal research topic on AI-enabled robotics
and wireless power transfer.

Topics include, but are not limited to:
- Learning-based charging for mobile robots
- Inductive and resonant power links for swarms
- Energy-aware planning and scheduling
- Hardware design for contactless power

Manuscript summary deadline: 30 October 2026
Manuscript deadline: 15 February 2027

Details: https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fjournal.example.org%2Fresearch-topics%2F80001&data=05%7C02%7Cuser%40example.edu%7C0f1e2d3c4b5a69788796a5b4c3d2e1f0%7C00000000000000000000000000000000%7C1%7C0%7C639000000000000006%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=ZXhhbXBsZS1zZGF0YS00006%3D&reserved=0

Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 21:51:52 -0500
From: Lane Nakashima <emerson.quillon57@example.edu>
Subject: [robotics-worldwide] [Meetings] Deadline Extension - IROS 2026
 Workshop on Search Algorithms for Robot Learning

Hi all,

The paper deadline for our IROS 2026 workshop on search algorithms for
robot learning is extended to September 12.

Workshop page:
<https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fworkshop.example.org%2Fsearch-for-robot-learning-2026&data=05%7C02%7Cuser%40example.edu%7C0f1e2d3c4b5a69788796a5b4c3d2e1f0%7C00000000000000000000000000000000%7C1%7C0%7C639000000000000013%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=ZXhhbXBsZS1zZGF0YS00013%3D&reserved=0>

We invite papers on tree search, sampling-based planning, and search inside
learned models for robotics. Papers may be up to four pages plus
references and will be reviewed by the organizers.

Topics of interest include:
- Search in learned world models
- Sampling-based planning with learned priors
- Exploration and curiosity for manipulation
- Test-time search for robot policies
- Benchmarks and evaluation protocols

Interest form:
<https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fforms.example.org%2Fsearch-workshop-interest&data=05%7C02%7Cuser%40example.edu%7C0f1e2d3c4b5a69788796a5b4c3d2e1f0%7C00000000000000000000000000000000%7C1%7C0%7C639000000000000014%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=ZXhhbXBsZS1zZGF0YS00014%3D&reserved=0>

Best,
Lane Nakashima
on behalf of the organizers
*https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Flane.example.org%2F&data=05%7C02%7Cuser%40example.edu%7C0f1e2d3c4b5a69788796a5b4c3d2e1f0%7C00000000000000000000000000000000%7C1%7C0%7C639000000000000015%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=ZXhhbXBsZS1zZGF0YS00015%3D&reserved=0*
